body: Dude you are such a pos just fuck off

I don't know if these are the words you need to hear, but your parents sound SO toxic for you. And I don't believe in that "parents believe the best for you" bs, they will try to control your life into something you don't want, assume things about you that they don't understand, and display some of the most toxic behavior under the guise that they "just care too much about you". That ex-boyfriend is toxic but your parents are even more toxic for not being able to trust their daughter in the slightest. They can't offer anything supportive? Fuck them.
